rules.description: Review versions of short papers have at most 4 pages of content, figures and tables included; references, the Limitations section, an ethics section at the end, acknowledgements and appendices after the references do not count. Source: https://2025.aclweb.org/calls/main_conference_papers/, https://acl-org.github.io/ACLPUB/formatting.html and https://aclrollingreview.org/cfp
The text is 11 point roman, single-spaced. Source: https://acl-org.github.io/ACLPUB/formatting.html
All papers use A4 paper format (21 cm x 29.7 cm). Source: https://acl-org.github.io/ACLPUB/formatting.html
The paper has a dedicated section titled "Limitations"; papers without it are desk rejected. Source: https://aclrollingreview.org/cfp and https://acl-org.github.io/ACLPUB/formatting.html
Review versions do not include acknowledgements. Source: https://acl-org.github.io/ACLPUB/formatting.html
Review is double-blind: the submission must not identify its authors. Source: https://2025.aclweb.org/calls/main_conference_papers/
